h: The Field of Holy Apples Reveals the Fragrance of Yisrael

p: At the Shabbos night meal we say:
of Chakal Tapuchin Kaddishin, the Field of Holy Apples";
and on Yom Tov we say:
"of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah."
which is the attribute of Malchus,
in the midst of the Children of Israel."
And it is called "a field that Hashem has blessed,"
this is a field of apples."
And in the language of the holy Zohar
it is called Chakal Tapuchin Kaddishin.
But the day of Shabbos is known
to correspond to the attribute of Malchus;
as is written in the holy Zohar,
that the seven days of Creation
correspond to the seven lower attributes;
And the attribute of Malchus is called "field,"
along the lines of what Tosafos say
that the wife is the "field" of the husband;
and everywhere the holy Zohar calls
Z'eir Anpin and the attribute of Malchus
And in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 65:22) it says:
is like the scent of a field.'"
since at the beginning of the world's creation it was
that the essence of the Shechinah would be among the lower beings,
moving about in the garden toward the breeze of the day";
the place of the revelation of the attribute of Malchus,
that is, the recognition of the Kingship of Heaven.
when Adam HaRishon was driven out of Gan Eden,
the place of the Mikdash remained
the place fit for the resting of the Shechinah,
וְכֵן נִדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כב, ז)
And so it is expounded (Bereishis Rabbah 22:7):
"'And it was, when they were in the field' (Bereishis 4:8)
and 'field' means only the Beis HaMikdash,
'Zion shall be plowed as a field.'"
the Beis HaMikdash had not been built,
the place fit for the Beis HaMikdash
and for the resting of the Shechinah
called the place of the Mikdash "field"
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קכב, א)
And it says in the holy Zohar (I 122a):
"For there is a field and there is a field:
in which all blessings and holiness dwell,
'like the scent of a field that Hashem has blessed';
in which all destruction, impurity, annihilation,
For just as there is an attribute of Malchus in holiness,
וְיֵשׁ גַּם כֵּן מִדַּת מַלְכוּת בַּקְּלִיפָּה
and there is also an attribute of Malchus in the kelipah;
for the attribute of Malchus of the kelipah.
And because of this we find (Pesachim 54b):
"And when will the guilty kingdom fall?"
שֶׁנִּקְרָא כֵן עַל שֵׁם הַכָּתוּב (מַלְאָכִי א, ד)
that it is so called after the pasuk (Malachi 1:4):
"And they shall call it the border of wickedness."
And so it is called "the kingdom of Edom"
and that is because Esav is a chariot
for the attribute of Malchus of the kelipah;
"a field in which all destruction," etc.,
And Esav, who had "trapping in his mouth,"
that he had been in the house of study
עַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה סָבוּר יִצְחָק
for the attribute of Malchus of holiness;
is like the scent of a field that Hashem has blessed."
But in truth it was Yaakov
who was a chariot for this attribute,
And it is written, "like the scent of a field,"
we find the matter of scent;
"He squeezed his cloak, and its scent," etc.
And so regarding Alexander of Macedon:
this spring comes from Gan Eden"
"And his fragrance shall be like the Levanon";
and it says in the Gemara (Yoma 39b):
Because it whitens the sins of Yisrael."
"And the scent of your nose like apples."
And Tosafos (Shabbos 88a, end of the amud)
that Yisrael are likened to an apple
"Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest";
why did they not bring it from this pasuk,
in which Yisrael are likened to an apple?
But the matter of "And the scent of your nose like apples"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (עֵירוּבִין כא, ב)
is along the lines of what they said (Eruvin 21b):
these are the completely wicked," etc.;
are destined to give off fragrance."
"And the scent of your nose like apples";
along the lines of what they said
the mucus of a person's nose";
וְאִם נָתַן בִּיבָהּ עַל פִּתְחָהּ וְכוּלֵּי
"And if he placed its drainpipe at its entrance," etc.;
"and He placed his drainpipe at his entrance,
and it is becoming and it is his praise."
"And the scent of your nose like apples":
which signify the transgressors of Yisrael
are destined to give off fragrance.
And this is what is written (Bereishis 2:7):
"And He breathed into his nostrils the breath of life";
כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁמַת רוּחַ חַיִּים בְּאַפָּיו
"all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life,"
is expounded as referring to the souls of the tzaddikim,
And this is "And the scent of your nose like apples":
are destined to give off fragrance,
for Hashem Yisbarach will refine them,
except that which emerges from within darkness,
except that which emerges from within evil,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
and he will be in the aspect of
כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁמַת רוּחַ חַיִּים בְּאַפָּיו
"all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life,"
And this is what is expounded in the Midrash
"'And he smelled the scent of his garments'
"like the scent of a field that Hashem has blessed,"
which is a field of apples.
וְלָכֵן שָׁם בַּגְּמָרָא שַׁבָּת הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
Therefore, there in the Gemara Shabbos mentioned above,
when Yisrael put "we will do" before "we will hear"
that is, that they are prepared
רַק מַה שֶּׁהוּא רְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
except what is the will of Hashem Yisbarach
that Yisrael are likened to an apple
"Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest," etc.
Hashem Yisbarach is likened to an apple tree,
were likened then to an apple,
for then there was the union
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
"His cheeks are like a bed of spices"
אַף שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר עַל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
even though it is said about HaKadosh Baruch Hu.
And because of this it did not bring there
the pasuk "And the scent of your nose";
and the question of Tosafos is resolved.
And regarding Shabbos we have already said many times
that just as the Mikdash is in place,
the place of the resting of the Shechinah;
for Shabbos is the time of the revelation of His Kingship,
in the midst of the Children of Israel,
and the attribute of Knesses Yisrael
is the Field of Holy Apples,
which is the attribute of Malchus,
